newsitem.title: FINLAND: Valmet to make Porsche cars-paper.
newsitem.headline: Valmet to make Porsche cars-paper.

text.p: Finnish Valmet Automotive and German sportscar maker Dr.Ing.h.c.f. Porsche AG will announce on Friday that Valmet will start making Porsche's Boxster model in Finland, the daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Friday.

The two companies "will announce today an agreement about starting production of Porsche's Boxster model in Uusikaupunki," the newspaper said referring to Valmet Automotive's plant in south-western Finland.
The paper projected annual production of 5,000-10,000 Porsche Boxster cars at Uusikaupunki.

The main reason for the agreement is that Porsche lacks capacity to build the Boxster model at a pace corresponding to demand, the paper said, adding customers were currently forced to wait over a year to buy a new Porsche Boxster -- a two-seat cabriolet.
German weekly Wirtschaftswoche reported earlier this week that Porsche was in talks with Valmet Automotive about starting production of Boxster cars at Uusikaupunki.
Valmet Automotive is part of Finnish engineering group Valmet Oy, whose core business is paper and board machines.
